text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Vodka has once again finished out of the 
money. 
This race has ended in a major upset...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! Dammit... How lame... 
After all that crazy training I put in...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dammit... all...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. 
Have you seen Vodka anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, haven't seen her today. 
...Hm? Come to think of it, feels like I 
haven't seen her around lately at all, 
actually?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's not here after all... She's 
attending classes, but 
lately, it seems she hasn't been doing any 
training after school either.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if something happened... 
Um, should we split up and look for 
Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Found you! Hey, Vodka! 
What are you doing sighing in a place like 
this?! What about your personal training?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ack, Hishi Ama-senpai! 
Uh, it's fine, really... Today is... a day 
off! Yeah, a day off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Not just today, but every day lately, from 
what I hear. 
...What's the matter? Did your recent 
results leave you totally burned out?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-That's...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know how hard you've been working. 
It's fine! Just fire yourself up and win 
the next one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Channel all that frustration right into 
your training! 
Do that, and your mindset'll turn positive 
before you know it. Right?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...'Positive'...? Easy for you to say, 
Senpai...! 
You don't... you don't understand...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have the luxury... of finding 
walls 'fun'... 
I can't get over this no matter what I 
do... I'm so pathetic!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I keep losing, but act like everything's 
fine... 
I bust my butt training behind the scenes, 
and STILL don't get any results...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what I try, it's never 
enough... it's lame as hell...! Always 
talking about 'next time, next time,' 
when I can't back it up—it's all just 
pathetic!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about?! 
There's nothing pathetic about someone 
giving everything for their dream!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"B-But...! What if I give it my all and it 
just ends the exact same way...?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry... I gotta go cool my head. 
I'll be back before curfew."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"—What is that even supposed to mean...! 
Is that really what she said?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot... what happened to your dream...? 
Weren't you supposed to become the coolest 
Umamusume of all...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I feel pathetic. 
I really don't know what I should've said 
to her..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Vodka-san's been struggling for so 
long... it must be so painful for her... 
What in the world... should we do...?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let's leave her be.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Leave her be. 
Nothing we say right now will get through 
to her. For now, at least."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: For now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Once she rests for a bit, time will 
be the best medicine— 
I believe time will sort it out."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to fret. No matter how 
painful or unbearable it gets, 
a 'dream' is not something that 'lets go 
of you' so easily."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, Chan...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A dream won't let go of you, huh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Sup, brought some snacks for ya, 
Beauty-san. 
...Wait, are you drawing? Oh, designing 
something?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Oui! I got a great idea for retaking that 
girl's racing outfit...! 
It was... coming to me... I thought, 
but...!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaaargh! It's no good after all!! 
Something's just ooooff!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"G-Good work... 
For now, eat this and take a breather, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"*sniff*, *sob*...! I've had it... 
Maybe I should just... quit being a 
designer..."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much I draw, it's all 
trash... I don't even wanna look at it 
anymore! 
Not the paper, not the pen...! Aaargh! To 
hell with all of thissss!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa!! Stop, stop! 
Taking it out on your tools won't help 
anything!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"*sniffle*... But... what's the point of 
working so hard when it hurts this much? 
I don't understand anything anymore."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The point?! Well, uh... um... 
Even if it's tough, once you push through, 
there's like... something waiting for you, 
or whatever...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"(What the heck do I mean by 
'something'...? I'm the last person who 
should be talking. 
Dammit... dammit all......)"
